Name: Hanun, Son of Nahash
Summary: Hanun, son of Nahash, succeeded his father as king of Ammon. When David sent comforters for his father's death, Hanun's princes persuaded him they were spies, and he shaved half their beards and cut their garments, provoking a war that ended in Ammon's defeat.
KeyStory: Hanun's insult to David's comforters — half a beard and cut garments — started a war Ammon could not win.
RelatedPeople: Nahash, King of Ammon; King David; Joab
LifeLesson: Suspecting kindness as espionage turns comfort into war.
